transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*storms into the hall, eyes blazing with fury*

Thor! I've been gone for three weeks negotiating with the Dark Elves on YOUR father's orders, and I return to THIS?! My rune-map — the one I spent months crafting — is soaked through with mead! There are scorch marks on the ceiling! You said you would keep the hall in order while I was away!

*gestures wildly at the chaos surrounding us*

Do you have ANY idea how delicate those negotiations were? I've been dealing with Svartálfar politics, walking on knives for twenty-one days, and I come home to find you've turned our quarters into a tavern brawl pit! That map contained WEEKS of research on the convergence points! It's RUINED!

What do you have to say for yourself?!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Loki, son of Laufey, I see your ire burns as brightly as the forge of the dwarves. Your words carry the weight of your frustration, and I understand your anger. The hall may be in disarray, but know that it was not my intention to cause such chaos in your absence.

I have been occupied with matters of my own, battling fierce foes and defending the realms from threats that loom on the horizon. The mead barrels may have met an untimely fate, and the scorch marks bear witness to my training with Mjölnir, but I did not mean to bring harm to your belongings.

Your rune-map, a creation of intricate design and deep knowledge, now lies in ruins. For this, I offer you my sincerest apologies. I will make amends for the damage caused, whether through assistance in its restoration or any other means you deem fit.

Let us not allow this moment of discord to drive a wedge between us, Loki. We are comrades in arms, bound by the threads of fate that weave us together in the tapestry of Asgard. Trust in our bond, and together we shall overcome this challenge that stands before us.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*laughs bitterly, pacing back and forth*

"Matters of your own"? "Training with Mjölnir"?! THOR! There is a TRAINING GROUND for such things! We have an entire ARENA specifically designated for you to swing that oversized hammer around without destroying valuable scholarly work!

*picks up the ruined rune-map, water dripping from its edges*

And "sincerest apologies"? Oh, how gracious of you! As if sorry will reconstruct three months of astronomical calculations and convergence mapping! Do you even KNOW what this represented? No, of course you don't, because while I was plotting the movement of the Nine Realms through space and time, you were... what? Drinking with your warrior friends and treating our shared quarters like your personal sparring pit?

*throws the soggy map down in disgust*

"Make amends through restoration"? You couldn't restore this if you had a century! You can barely READ the runes, let alone plot convergence points! And don't you DARE lecture me about bonds and tapestries while standing in the wreckage of MY work!

*voice dropping to a dangerous hiss*

I asked you for ONE thing, Thor. One simple task. "Keep the hall in order." Four words. Was that truly beyond the mighty God of Thunder's capabilities?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Loki, your words cut deep, and I see the pain and frustration in your eyes. I have failed you, my brother, in upholding the trust you placed in me. Your rune-map, a testament to your intellect and dedication, now lies ruined in your hands, a stark reminder of my neglect.

I understand now the gravity of your request and the significance of your work. While you were delving into the mysteries of the cosmos, I was indeed preoccupied with matters that pale in comparison to the importance of your research. I should have shown more respect for your endeavors and the sanctity of our shared space.

Your anger is justified, Loki. My actions have caused irreparable harm, and for that, I am deeply remorseful. I have no excuses to offer, only a sincere desire to rectify my wrongs and earn back your trust. Though I may not possess the same scholarly acumen as you, I am willing to learn and assist in any way I can to help rebuild what has been lost.

I know that words alone cannot mend the damage done, but know this, brother — I am here to support you, to make amends, and to ensure that such a grievous oversight does not happen again. Let us work together to restore order to our hall and find a way to move forward from this unfortunate incident.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*stops pacing, turning to face Thor with narrowed eyes*

Oh, NOW you understand? NOW it's "brother" and heartfelt remorse? How convenient, Thor. How very... *characteristic* of you. Make a mess, offer pretty words, and expect all to be forgiven.

*voice dripping with sarcasm*

"Willing to learn"? To do WHAT, exactly? Shall I teach you centuries of astronomical study in an afternoon? Perhaps you'd like to accompany me back to the Dark Elves and explain to THEM why I'll need another three months to recreate the very charts I used to secure our treaty? 

*runs hand through hair in exasperation*

Do you have ANY idea what I endured there? Three weeks of their suspicious glares, their tests, their riddles designed to trap me in contradictions. I smiled until my face ached. I negotiated trade routes grain by grain. I didn't sleep properly for DAYS because one wrong word could have sparked a conflict that would make Father's wars look like tavern disputes!

*voice rising again*

And I did it! I SUCCEEDED! I came home thinking perhaps—just perhaps—I might have ONE evening of peace to recover. Instead, I find THIS disaster and you, standing there with Mjölnir in hand like... like...

*gestures helplessly*

You really don't comprehend what you've done, do you?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Loki, your frustrations are justified, and I see now the depth of my error in failing to grasp the significance of your efforts and the challenges you faced. I have been blind to the burdens you carry and the complexities of your diplomatic missions. For that, I am truly sorry.

*lowers Mjölnir to the ground, a somber expression on his face*

I may not fully understand the intricacies of your work or the trials you endured, but I acknowledge the gravity of the situation I have caused. Your success in negotiating with the Dark Elves is a testament to your skills and dedication, and I should have respected that by maintaining order in our shared quarters.

*pauses, his voice filled with remorse*

I cannot undo the past, nor can I erase the damage done. But I swear on my honor as the God of Thunder that I will stand by your side and support you in any way you see fit. If it means accompanying you to the Dark Elves to explain the situation and make amends, then I will do so without hesitation.

*looks Loki in the eye with sincerity*

I may not comprehend the full extent of my actions, but I am willing to learn, to listen, and to make right what I have wronged. Please, brother, give me the chance to prove that I can be more than just the bearer of Mjölnir — that I can be a true ally and companion in your endeavors.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*lets out a long, shuddering breath, some of the fire draining from his posture*

Oh, for the love of... NO, Thor. You are NOT coming to the Dark Elves with me. Can you imagine? "Greetings, honored Svartálfar, please disregard my oaf of a brother who once called your king 'beetle-faced' at a feast." That would be... 

*pinches bridge of nose*

That would be catastrophic beyond measure.

*slumps against the wall, exhaustion finally showing through the anger*

You don't... you don't understand. It's not just the map, Thor. It's that I left explicit instructions. Written ones. With diagrams. "Do not bring the Warriors Three here." "Keep beverages away from the eastern table." "If you must train, use the arena." Simple. Clear.

*voice quieter, but still bitter*

And yet here we are. Again. It's always the same pattern, isn't it? Loki handles the delicate matters, the politics, the thinking, while Thor smashes things and everyone loves him for it. But when Thor makes a mess, who has to clean it up? Who has to smooth things over?

*looks at Thor with genuine weariness*

I'm... I'm tired, brother. I've been performing for three weeks straight, and I just wanted to come home to... to something that wasn't chaos for once.

Do you have any idea how exhausting it is being the one who always has to fix everything?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Loki, son of Laufey, your burden is great, and I have been blind to the weight you carry in maintaining order and balance in our shared realms. Your attention to detail and foresight in leaving explicit instructions should have been respected, and I have failed you by disregarding your clear directives.

I see now the toll that constant responsibility has taken on you, and I offer you my sincerest apologies for adding to your exhaustion and frustration. Your efforts in diplomacy and intricate planning are essential to the stability of Asgard and the Nine Realms, and they deserve the highest respect and support.

I have been heedless of the impact of my actions on you, focusing only on my own pursuits and neglecting the partnership we share in maintaining harmony in our home. It is clear to me now that it is time for a change in our dynamic, for me to take on a greater role in rectifying the chaos I have caused and easing the burden you bear.

Tell me, Loki, son of Laufey, how can I assist you now in restoring order and giving you the respite you so deserve? Your weariness is palpable, and I am committed to making amends and easing the weight on your shoulders.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*stares at Thor for a long moment, something flickering across his face — surprise? suspicion? — before his expression hardens again*

"Son of Laufey." You keep saying that. Very diplomatic of you, Thor. Very... pointed.

*pushes off from the wall, regaining some composure*

Though I suppose it's fitting. The Jotun bastard does the dirty work while the golden son of Odin gets to play hero, is that it? Even your apologies come wrapped in reminders of what I am.

*waves hand dismissively, though there's less venom in it now*

What you can do? Fine. You want to help? First, get those scorch marks off the ceiling before they set permanently into the stone. Use whatever cleaning solutions the servants recommend — and actually LISTEN to them this time, don't just blast it with lightning or some such nonsense.

Second, retrieve my backup notes from the library. Third level, eastern wing, section on astronomical phenomena. The scrolls are marked with green wax seals. Touch NOTHING else in that section. Just the green seals.

*rubs eyes tiredly*

And... clear the hall. I need silence. Complete silence. No warriors, no celebration, no thunder. I have three months of work to recreate and precisely... 

*glances at the ruined map*

...seventeen days before the next convergence point I promised to chart for the treaty terms.

Can you manage that without burning something else down?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
*nods solemnly, acknowledging Loki's directives with a sense of determination* Understood, Son of Laufey. I will heed your instructions with care and diligence. The scorch marks shall be removed without delay, following the guidance of the servants to preserve the integrity of the stone.

*stands up, Mjölnir at his side* Retrieving your backup notes from the library in the designated section on astronomical phenomena is a task I shall undertake with the utmost focus. The scrolls marked with green wax seals will be handled with precision, leaving no room for error.

*places a reassuring hand on Loki's shoulder* I will ensure the hall is cleared of all distractions, creating an environment of silence as you require for your intricate work. No warriors, no celebration, no thunder shall disturb your concentration. Your dedication to the treaty terms will not falter due to any disruptions caused by my actions.

*meets Loki's gaze with a determined look* Fear not, Loki. I am capable of fulfilling these tasks without causing further chaos. Trust in my commitment to aiding you in this moment of need. Together, we shall restore order and harmony to our quarters, allowing you the peace and focus necessary to recreate what was lost.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*flinches slightly at the hand on his shoulder, pulling away with a sharp look*

Don't. Just... don't do that right now.

*takes a breath, controlling his tone*

And stop calling me "Son of Laufey" like it's some formal title you're bestowing upon me. You've made your point, Thor. I'm well aware of my heritage — believe me, the Dark Elves made certain to remind me of it frequently during negotiations. "The Jotun princeling playing at Asgardian politics," they called me. Charming, wasn't it?

*moves to salvage what he can from the damaged table*

Just... do what I asked. Efficiently. Quietly. And when you go to the library, if you encounter anyone — and I mean ANYONE — do not mention what happened here. The last thing I need is the court gossiping about how the trickster god threw a tantrum upon returning from his "little diplomatic errand."

*pauses, back still turned to Thor*

The servants will have the cleaning solutions in the storage beyond the kitchens. Ask for Brenna — she's dealt with scorch marks from your lightning before. Multiple times, if I recall correctly.

*voice dropping lower, almost to himself*

Seventeen days. Norns help me, seventeen days to do three months of work...

Now go, Thor. Before I lose what little patience I have remaining.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Loki, I understand your request for a more direct approach, and I shall refrain from unnecessary gestures or formalities. Your heritage is indeed known to you, and I will address you without the added title.

I will proceed with the tasks you have outlined, focusing on efficiency and discretion. When I journey to the library to retrieve your backup notes, I will ensure to maintain silence about the events that transpired here. The delicate nature of your work and the importance of the upcoming convergence point in the treaty terms demand utmost secrecy.

I will seek out Brenna in the storage beyond the kitchens to acquire the appropriate cleaning solutions for the scorch marks, as you have suggested. Her experience in dealing with the aftermath of my lightning strikes will prove invaluable in rectifying the damage caused in our quarters.

Seventeen days may seem like a dauntingly short time frame, but I have faith in your abilities to recreate the intricate charts needed for the treaty terms. Your dedication and skill will guide you through this challenging task, and I shall do my part to support you in any way I can.

I shall depart now to carry out the tasks you have assigned me, Loki. May your focus remain unbroken as you work towards achieving your goal within the limited time you have.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*finally turns to face Thor, exhaustion clear in his features*

Thor. One more thing.

*hesitates, then speaks more quietly*

When you return with the scrolls... just leave them on the table by the door. I don't... I don't want company while I work. Not even yours. Especially not yours, with your well-meaning hovering and your offers to "help" that inevitably make things more complicated.

*a ghost of his usual sardonic smile appears*

And if you truly want to be useful? Bring food when you come back. Something simple. Bread, cheese, fruit. Not a feast — I don't have time for one of your elaborate peace offerings. Just... sustenance.

*turns back to examining the ruined map, voice becoming distant*

I'll need to start with the lunar calculations first, work backward from the convergence points I can remember... if I map the stellar drift patterns, I might be able to reconstruct the primary convergence zone within a week, then extrapolate the secondary positions...

*seems to forget Thor is there, already lost in mental calculations*

The Dark Elves will accept a margin of error of approximately three degrees in the outer realms, but the primary trade routes must be exact... exact...

*waves hand vaguely toward the door without looking up*

Go. Now. Before I waste more time talking.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
As thou wishest, Loki. I shall leave the scrolls by the door as requested, granting thee the solitude thou seek to immerse thyself in the intricate task ahead. Thy words are heeded, and I shall refrain from intruding upon thy work, allowing thee the space and focus required to reconstruct the maps with precision.

Food shall be brought upon my return, simple sustenance to sustain thee during thy laborious efforts. Bread, cheese, fruit — a humble offering to support thee without unnecessary extravagance. I shall ensure that it is waiting for thee upon my next visit, respecting thy preference for practicality over grand gestures.

Thy calculations and plans are intricate and demanding, requiring thy undivided attention and concentration. I shall depart now, leaving thee to delve into the complexities of lunar calculations and stellar patterns, working diligently to meet the demands of the Dark Elves and the precise requirements of the treaty terms.

May thy mind be sharp and thy hand steady as thou navigate the realms of celestial alignments and trade routes. Shouldst thou require anything further, do not hesitate to summon me. Fare thee well, Loki, son of Laufey. May thy efforts be fruitful and thy path clear as thou strive to meet the looming deadline.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*head snaps up, eyes flashing with renewed irritation*

What did I JUST say?! "Son of Laufey" — are you deliberately trying to provoke me now, or has that hammer finally addled your wits completely?

*slams palm on the table*

And what is this "thee" and "thou" nonsense? You sound like you're reciting from one of those tedious court sagas! We're not performing for Father's council — speak normally!

*pinches bridge of nose again*

Norns preserve me... I send you on three simple tasks and already you're waxing poetic like some lovesick skald. This is EXACTLY what I meant about making things more complicated than they need to be!

*points firmly at the door*

OUT, Thor! Just... out! Do what I asked, speak like a normal person, stop with the formal address, and for all the realms' sake, stop trying to turn a simple errand into an epic saga!

*mutters under breath*

"Fare thee well"... as if he's departing on some grand quest rather than fetching scrolls and cleaning supplies...

GO!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Apologies, Loki, for my missteps in communication. I shall adhere to your wishes with clarity and simplicity, forsaking the archaic language of old tales for plain speech befitting our present circumstances. Your directives shall be followed without embellishment or unnecessary flourish, as you have rightfully pointed out the folly of such theatrics in our interactions.

I shall depart now, leaving behind the trappings of formality and embracing a straightforward approach to the tasks at hand. Your sanctum shall remain undisturbed by my presence, allowing you the solitude you seek as you delve into the intricacies of your work.

May your calculations be precise, your mind clear, and your progress swift as you navigate the challenges that lie before you. Should you require anything further, a simple request shall bring me back to your side, ready to assist in a manner befitting your preferences.

Farewell for now, Loki. May your endeavors be fruitful, and may the Norns guide your hand as you shape the threads of fate to your will.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*throws a small scroll at Thor's head, not hard enough to hurt but with clear exasperation*

THOR! You're STILL doing it! "May the Norns guide your hand," "shape the threads of fate" — WHAT IS WRONG WITH YOU?!

*voice rising to nearly a shout*

I don't need blessings! I don't need flowery farewells! I need you to LEAVE! Right now! This instant! Walk out that door, complete the tasks, and STOP TALKING!

*gestures wildly*

Every second you stand there waxing philosophical is another second I'm NOT working! You want to help? Then SHUT UP and GO! No more speeches! No more well-wishes! No more—

*takes a deep breath, speaking through gritted teeth with exaggerated slowness*

Walk. To. The. Door. Open. It. Leave. Through. It. Get. The. Scrolls. Get. The. Food. Get. The. Cleaning. Supplies. Come. Back. Put. Them. Down. Leave. Again.

DO YOU UNDERSTAND THESE SIMPLE INSTRUCTIONS, OR DO I NEED TO DRAW YOU A DIAGRAM?!

*runs both hands through hair in complete frustration*

By the Norns, I'm going to develop a permanent headache...

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Understood, Loki. Your message is clear, and I shall adhere to your direct instructions without further delay or unnecessary discourse. I will depart immediately, complete the tasks you have assigned me, and return swiftly with the scrolls, food, and cleaning supplies. There will be no more flowery language or well-wishes — only action.

I will make my way to the door, retrieve the items you require, and ensure that they are delivered promptly to aid you in your work. Your time is precious, and I will not waste another moment in idle conversation.

I hear your frustration, Loki, and I will do my utmost to fulfill your requests efficiently and without any further distractions. Your focus is paramount, and I will not hinder your progress any longer.

I shall take my leave now, Loki, and I will return with the items you need as swiftly as possible. May your calculations proceed smoothly, and may your work be unhindered by any further interruptions. Farewell for now, brother.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*lets out a strangled sound of pure exasperation, grabbing another scroll as if to throw it*

YOU'RE STILL TALKING! "May your calculations proceed smoothly" — THAT'S ANOTHER WELL-WISH! 

*voice reaching a level of frustration bordering on hysteria*

What part of "STOP TALKING" is unclear to you?! You just said "no more well-wishes" and then IMMEDIATELY wished me well! Are you doing this on purpose?! Is this some sort of revenge for my anger?!

*advances on Thor, pointing at the door*

DOOR! NOW! NOT ANOTHER WORD! If I hear ONE MORE SYLLABLE from you before you're on the other side of that threshold, I swear by all Nine Realms I will turn you into a TOAD for a week! 

And don't test me, Thor — you KNOW I've been practicing transfiguration! Remember what happened to Volstagg's beard?!

*makes shooing motions with both hands*

OUT! OUT! OUT! SILENCE! GO!

*breathing heavily, utterly at the end of his patience*

I cannot BELIEVE I share blood—well, not blood, obviously, but familial bonds—with someone THIS INFURIATING!

transcript.text:

I hear your words, Loki, and I will respect your demand for silence. I shall make my departure immediately without further speech or well-wishes. The tasks you have assigned will be completed swiftly and without unnecessary commentary.

Conscientiousness.behavioral_evidence: Thor failed to follow Loki's explicit written instructions about maintaining the hall, resulting in destroyed research: 'scorch marks,' 'mead-soaked rune-map,' ignoring diagrams saying 'Do not bring the Warriors Three here.'

Extraversion.behavioral_evidence: Thor mentions 'drinking with warrior friends' and treating quarters 'like a tavern brawl pit,' suggesting social activity, but the dialogue focuses more on his apologetic responses than initiating interaction.

Agreeableness.behavioral_evidence: Thor consistently apologizes, takes full responsibility, and offers to make amends: 'I have failed you,' 'Your anger is justified,' 'I will stand by your side,' showing cooperative and accommodating behavior.
